description: When a Florida drawbridge opens next, right now: 80+ bridges with a federal schedule (Miami River, Miami Beach, Fort Lauderdale and the New River, Palm Beach, the Space Coast, St. Augustine, Jacksonville, Tampa's Hillsborough River, Pinellas beach causeways, Sarasota, Venice, the Caloosahatchee, the Keys). Says if it opens on signal now, the next scheduled opening, rush-hour closures, call-ahead hours, closed clearance, and the rule. Give a position for the closest ones, or a bridge name.

boat_height_ft.description: The boat's height above the water, to say if it fits under closed

lat.description: Latitude of where the person is or will be

name.description: Part of a bridge name, e.g. Brickell, Las Olas, Corey Causeway, Bridge of Lions
